prompt: prepclass — Macroeconomics, session on monetary policy and the Fed's rate decisions. We discussed the Taylor Rule, how central banks set rates, and the 2022-2024 rate hiking cycle to fight post-COVID inflation. What do I need to know before tomorrow?

assertions.description: Output contains all three required sections: Previous Session Summary, In the News, and Devil's Advocate
Previous session summary is between 150 and 450 words
Exactly 3 news items are listed, each with a source name and a date
All news items are dated within the last 6 months (after October 2024)
The Devil's Advocate section presents a genuine counterargument to the class material (e.g. challenges the Taylor Rule or the effectiveness of rate hikes)
